In addition to stats normally present in Starbound, FU adds a host of its own as well. Some may be character stats, some may be weapon stats. Some may be both! They are detailed within this guide for easy access later.

^green;Charisma^white; - When shopping on FU space stations, Charisma helps you to make a profit by influencing ^cyan;Selling and Buying^reset; values. A high charisma means a high income ratio! Note that this only applies on Space Station trades and their related Kiosks for the time being. As a special note, every 33% charisma will allow you to bring an additional crewmember with you in the field. Be warned, penalties to charisma can have the opposite effect!

^green;Stun Chance^white; - With blunt weapons, each hit has a chance to stun enemies. Likewise with successful shieldbashes. This stat influences the chance that this stun will occur. This also can occur with daggers, rapiers, and a few other weapons.

^green;Shieldbash Chance^white; - When blocking with your shield, you have a chance to shieldbash. This stat influences the chances that the bash succeeds.

^green;Shieldbash Push^white; - How far a shieldbash will push an enemy, and how much damage it will inflict when successful.

^green;Projectile Count^white; - Typically only seen as a stat on weapons, it is indicated in most gun tooltips by 3 diagonally aligned bullets. This indicates how many projectiles are fired at once.

^green;Burst Count^white; - Exclusively on weapons. Indicated in the tooltip by a spread of 4 small bullets. These weapons fire a burst of projectiles in sequence.

^green;Tech Bonus^white; - There are various types of Tech Bonus. These will be listed when relevant. Any such bonus will influence techs. For example 'Jump Tech +25%' increase the efficiency of any Jump related techs by that amount.

^green;Weapon Mastery^white; - Occasionally you'll find gear that can grant 'Weapon Mastery' at different levels. Weapon Mastery provides additional benefits to particular weapons.

^green;Crit Chance^white; - The likelihood that you will score a successful critical attack with your weapon. Note that this can be a stat on both you -and- on a weapon. They will combine.

^green;Crit Damage Bonus^white; - The total bonus applied, in percentage, to critical damage strikes.

^green;Leech^white; - A form of healing that is unaffected by normal healing modifiers. This healing is divided over a duration (10 seconds at base); +10% leech means you will heal up to 1% of your health per second for 10 seconds per instance.

^green;Maximum Leech^white; - The maximum amount of healing you can have at a time, from leech. The default is 10%; from all leech instances you will not be able to heal more than 10% of your health per second.

^#e43774;Madness^white; - A measurement of your current sanity. The higher the value, the crazier you are. More than 50 effects can occur from madness, and not all are bad. You can spend Madness in the ^#e43774;Metaphysics Research Tree^reset;.



^blue;--------------------------------------------------^reset;
^yellow;The Frackin Wiki
^blue;--------------------------------------------------^reset;
If you need the help of a Wiki, use our ^cyan;official wiki^reset; here:
^green;frackinuniverse.miraheze.org^reset;

^red;Do not^reset; use the Fandom wiki. It is horribly outdated.

Starboundに通常存在する統計に加えて、FUは自身のホストも追加する。 文字統計値、武器統計値など。 両方かもしれない。 後日簡単にアクセスできるように、このガイドで詳しく説明されています。

^green; カリスマ ^white; - FU宇宙ステーションで買い物をするとき、カリスマは ^cyan; 販売と購入 ^reset; 値に影響を与えて利益を上げるのに役立ちます。 高カリスマ性は高所得率を意味します! なお、これは当面は宇宙ステーションの取引とその関連キオスクにのみ適用される。 特別な注意として、すべての 33% カリスマでは、フィールドに追加のクルーメンバーを連れて行くことができます。 注意してください、カリスマへの罰則は反対の効果を持つことができます!

^green;気絶 確率 ^white; - 鈍い武器で、各ヒットは敵を刺すチャンスがあります。 同様に、シールドバッシュも成功した。 この統計は、このスタンが発生する可能性に影響を与えます。 これは短剣、レイピア、およびその他のいくつかの武器でも起こり得ます。

^green; Shieldbash 確率 ^white; - シールドでブロックすると、シールドバッシュを選択できます。 この統計は、bashが成功する可能性に影響を与えます。

^green; Shieldbash 押し出し ^white; - シールドバッシュが敵をどのくらい押し出すか、そしてそれが成功したときにどれだけの損害を与えるか。

^green;Projectile Count ^white; - 典型的には武器のステータスと見なされるだけであり、ほとんどの銃器の先端には3斜めに並んだ弾丸で示されています。 これは一度に発射される発射物の数を示しています。

^green;バーストカウント^white; - 武器に排他的。 4 小さな弾丸の広がりによってツールチップに表示します。 これらの武器は一連の発射物を発射する。

^green;Tech ボーナス ^white; - さまざまな種類のTech ボーナスがあります。 これらは関連する場合にリストされます。 そのようなボーナスは技術に影響を与えます。 例えば、'JumpTech+25%' は、ジャンプ関連の技術の効率をその量で向上させます。

^green;武器 習熟度 ^white; - 時には、異なるレベルで「武器 習熟度」を付与できるギアを見つけることがあります。 武器 習熟度は、特定の武器に追加のメリットを提供します。

^green;クリティカル率 ^white; - 武器でクリティカルアタックを成功させる可能性。 これは、武器のオンとオンの両方のステータスである可能性があることに注意してください。 組み合わせる。

^green;クリティカル ダメージボーナス ^white; - 重大なダメージストライクに対して適用される合計ボーナス。

^green;吸収^white; - 通常の治癒修飾剤の影響を受けない癒しの形態。 この癒しは、期間(期間)で分割されます。10 ベースで秒。 +10% リーチとは 癒しを 1% 毎秒の健康状態を 10 インスタンスあたり秒数

^green;最大リーチ^white; - リーチから一度に受けられる最大の癒し。 デフォルトは 10% です。すべてのリーチインスタンスから、毎秒のヘルスの 10% 以上のヒーリングを行うことはできません。

^#e43774;狂気^white; - あなたの現在の正気の測定。 値が高いほど、クレイジーです。 50 以上の効果は狂気から発生する可能性があり、すべてが悪いわけではありません。 狂気は^#e43774; 形而上学 研究 Tree ^reset; で過ごすことができます。



^blue; -------------------------------------------------- ^reset;
^yellow; ウィキの亀裂
^blue; -------------------------------------------------- ^reset;
Wikiのヘルプが必要な場合は、 ^cyan; 公式wiki ^reset; _ をここで使用します。
^green;frackinUniverse.miraheze.org ^reset;

^red; ^reset; は Fandom wiki を使用しないでください。 恐ろしく時代遅れです。

As our staff will confirm, all procedures and fees are final, refunds are not available. For your safety, these modifications will not persist through a respawn chamber. Our available benefits are as follows:

^red;Berserker Rage^reset;: ^green;25% More^reset; Power, Increased Movement Speed. -^red;50^reset;% Knockback Resistance, -^red;35^reset; Protection.

^gray;Glass Cannon^reset;: ^green;100% More^reset; Damage at the cost of ^red;90% Less^reset; Protection

^green;Immunization^reset;: Provides ^cyan;immunity^reset; to most negative status effects. ^red;10% Less^reset; Power and Protection.

^white;Juggernaut^reset;: You become ^cyan;immune^reset; to knockback and gain ^green;50^reset; protection, but your movement speed is reduced by ^red;33%^reset;.

^green;Toxic Cloud^reset;: Every 3 seconds a ^green;toxic cloud^reset; that lasts 5 seconds and deals 30 piercing damage is released at your location. Every time this happens, you take ^red;5^reset; piercing damage. ^red;20^reset;% Increased Hunger Drain.

^#B200FF;Experiment #322^reset;: Applies random ^green;positive^reset; and/or ^red;negative^reset; statuses every 10 seconds which last 15-25 seconds.

^red;Trollblood^reset;: Regenerate ^green;40^reset;% of damage taken over 5 seconds, at the cost of ^red;20% Less^reset; HP and ^red;50^reset;% increased Energy Block Time.

^green;Renergizer^reset;: ^green;50% More^reset; Energy, ^green;33% More^reset; Energy Regeneration. Hunger Drain increased by ^red;25^reset;%. ^red;100^reset;% Increased Energy Block Time.

^yellow;Hypopanic^reset;: ^green;33% More^reset; Energy Regen, -^red;50^reset; Energy. In addition, Increased movement speed the less energy you have (up to +^green;67^reset;% speed at 35% energy remaining). Taking damage briefly ^red;stops^reset; energy regen, and ^red;consumes energy^reset; for 150% of damage.

^green;Hivemind^reset;: While over 10% health, drains ^red;1.25^reset;% of your Maximum Health to ^green;shoot a projectile^reset; at the closest enemy, prioritizing targets not hit recently, in a medium radius with a clear line of fire every 0.5 seconds, dealing ^green;2.5^reset;% of your Max HP as base damage (^orange;affected by power multiplier^reset;) on impact and causing ^red;Beestings^reset;.

^cyan;Mitochondria^reset;: Consumes ^red;2^reset; energy to regenerate ^green;1^reset; health every 0.15 seconds. Energy will regenerate only at full health.

^#7A7D81;Shadow Repel^reset;: Increases shadow resistance by ^green;50^reset;% and grants ^cyan;immunity^reset; to shadow status effects, but reduces the overall effectiveness of other resistances (except physical) by ^red;33^reset;%.

^#C5B00A;Radiation Repel^reset;: Increases radiation resistance by ^green;50^reset;% and grants ^cyan;immunity^reset; to radiation status effects, but reduces the overall effectiveness of other resistances (except physical) by ^red;33^reset;%.

^#69B115;Poison Repel^reset;: Increases poison resistance by ^green;50^reset;% and grants ^cyan;immunity^reset; to poison status effects, but reduces the overall effectiveness of other resistances (except physical) by ^red;33^reset;%.

^#A1F1FE;Ice Repel^reset;: Increases ice resistance by ^green;50^reset;% and grants ^cyan;immunity^reset; to ice status effects, but reduces the overall effectiveness of other resistances (except physical) by ^red;33^reset;%.

^#E99400;Fire Repel^reset;: Increases fire resistance by ^green;50^reset;% and grants ^cyan;immunity^reset; to fire status effects, but reduces the overall effectiveness of other resistances (except physical) by ^red;33^reset;%.

^#9711E4;Electrical Repel^reset;: Increases electric resistance by ^green;50^reset;% and grants ^cyan;immunity^reset; to electric status effects, but reduces the overall effectiveness of other resistances (except physical) by ^red;33^reset;%.

^#6062EB;Cosmic Repel^reset;: Increases cosmic resistance by ^green;50^reset;% and grants ^cyan;immunity^reset; to cosmic status effects, but reduces the overall effectiveness of other resistances (except physical) by ^red;33^reset;%.

FrackinUniverse adds a large amount of armors (and foods) and enhances some older ones, allowing for a greater variety of playstyles. These can be very useful through gameplay and provide exceptionally useful benefits!

^yellow;Set Bonus Inheritance^reset;: As an important note, armors that are used to craft other armors can still be used to complete armor set bonuses for sets that were used in the crafting chain, so partially upgrading your set is still viable.

^orange;Stats^reset; : Vanilla players may notice there are more than they are used to, and even the ones they are used to have different ranges. FU presents a wider variety of armor classes to spice up your play, and does the same with food.

If you are more interested in damage, pick up Power Armor or Hyper Power Armor to trade defensive stats for offensive ones. Alternatively, pick up Tank or Hyper Tank sets to outlast your enemy. They come in melee OR ranged! Fighting not quite your thing? Pick up an Exploration oriented set, and be at home in your environment! You're guaranteed to locate a set that suits your playstyle somewhere out there!

^orange;Resistances^reset; : Many armors in FU come with inherent resistances. Many biome weather effects will simply stop affecting you once you hit an appropriate amount, and various enemy attacks will do less damage. Nifty, right? It gets better; upgrade your armor, and those resistances will increase!

^orange;Bonuses^reset; : Most are increases to your stats, plenty are conditional.
Any that say ^green;+value^reset; are typically additive increases. It can be a little confusing, however. As example: if it gives +^green;3^reset;% Crit Chance it increases your crit chance by a flat 3%, but if it says +^green;3^reset;% Energy Regen, that's 3% of your base. The easiest way to remember is to ask yourself...does it have a base of 0? If so, it likely is like Crit Chance! If a bonus says x^green;1.3^reset;, or ^green;More^reset;, that's a multiplier on the value you currently have. Have 1000% Damage somehow? 100% More (or 2x) would make it 2000%! Small note: Regen is usually per second.

Of course, some bonuses have hidden components we couldn't easily include, for tooltip space.
 Additionally, there are some other phrase uses to note. If a set bonus states that it grants immunity to ^green;ALL^reset; of a related effect, that typically means all biome weather ^orange;as well as^reset; specific status effects related to that element. For heat, that includes burning and even lava! For radiation, that includes rad-burn.
As a small side-note, some terms or symbols are used loosely. If you see a bonus with x/y, that means the bonuses are different based on how their conditions are met. For weapons, this means how many of that type. If you see something like (Machine) Pistols, that means the bonus applies to Machine Pistols OR Pistols. This is typically done for tooltip space.

^cyan;Mining Sets^reset; :
 Mining laser sets grant a lot more mining laser damage...but that bonus is reduced significantly if you are pairing them with something else. Using a mining laser with a pistol, as example: 2x Mining Laser Damage becomes 1.25x.
^orange;Colors^reset;: Colors are important in identifying and understanding bonuses. To start with, set bonuses are identified by a ^yellow;^reset;, while a ^green;^reset; is only visible in crafting interfaces to display resistances. If a bonus stat is ^green;GREEN^reset;, that means it is a good thing. ^red;RED^reset; means it is a bad thing. ^cyan;Cyan^reset; is for bonuses that are binary. They typically do not stack with similar effects. This will be especially apparent with various foods...so choose carefully. It is worth noticing that there is ONE exception to the rules regarding colors: Glow. If you see Glow in a color, that is usually the color of the glow effect.

^orange;Special Bonuses^reset; : Some sets have special bonuses that don't really display much information due to lack of space, an unfortunate limitation of the game. Here, some bonuses will be explained.

^cyan;Adaptive Armor^reset;: Multiplies the wearer's total defense based on current health percentage, scaling between the left value at 20% health and the right value at 100% health.

^cyan;Auto-Medic^reset;: More complicated than ordinary regeneration, this effect will restore more health per second at the cost of an equal percentage of energy. It will also decrease energy regen and increase energy regen lock-out multiplicatively at 2x the heal percent.

^cyan;Thorns^reset;: a nova of thorns when hit, ^cyan;Fire Burst^reset; makes a nova of fire instead.

^cyan;Summons Minions^reset;: summons short-lived allies to fight alongside you or distract enemies. These minions scale based on the lowest armor's tier, so upgrading it is essential! Upgrade ALL of the pieces.

^cyan;Life/Energy Shell^reset;: Gain damage absorption (shell) which scales based on a resource (health, energy) to protect your health, comes with a matching overhead bar to indicate its state. Regenerates quickly if you haven't taken damage recently. ^cyan;Shell Immunities^reset; are granted only while the shell holds. The numbers on the effect's label indicate the conversion rate relative to the resource's stats. In order: capacity, regeneration rate, and the delay upon taking damage before it begins regenerating.

^cyan;Life Shell^reset; specific: Regeneration rate is a direct percentage of health per second, lockout is in specified seconds.

^cyan;Energy Shell^reset; specific: Regeneration rate is a percentage of the energy regeneration stat, base vanilla regeneration is 58.5% per second. Special note due to balance: Minimum lockout time of 0.5 seconds, and a maximum regen rate of 50% per second.

^cyan;Gravity Normalization^reset;: Personal gravity too low? Up it goes. Too high? Down instead. Exception: Zero-gravity.

^cyan;Vital Power^reset; and ^cyan;Juggernaut^reset;: these effects are set bonus exclusive, and quite powerful; they grant one stat based on a percent of another. Vital power grants power as life, Juggernaut grants life as power.

^cyan;Undying Resolve^reset;: increases Protection as your life gets lower, up to the stated amount, while ^cyan;Immortal Resolve^reset; grants HP Regen instead. If a set grants either, it will grant ^cyan;Immortal Resolve^reset; to your pet.

^cyan;Dark Commander^reset;/^cyan;Beast Master^reset;: Increases Damage, Protection, HP and Speed of your pets (both) and crew (Dark Commander) by the listed percent, increases their jump ability by half of that, and regenerates HP at a sixth of that amount per second.

^cyan;Capturenaut^reset;: Increases pet count by 1, plus an additional 1 per 2 tiers (up to +2) of the lowest equipped set piece. Grants an additional +1 if using alongside the back item. This means a fully upgraded set will allow up to 5 additional pets!

^red;Wretchel Toxicity^reset;: Ingesting Wretchel reduces core stats and healing received, and drains health over time. These effects increase in severity the more you consume in a short time frame, as well as while your health is critically low. It will ^red;KILL^reset; you, if you are careless.

^cyan;Charisma^reset;: Your ability to bargain with Traders at space stations. The higher your charisma, the better the deal (and fatter your bank balance!)



^cyan;Pet/Crew Stat Inheritance^reset;:
Overall scaling is as follows: HP, directly from your character, rather than just equipped armor. Protection: applied as a multiplier to HP via a specific formula. Damage: directly from character sheet. Health Regen: Inherits as a flat amount, except in special cases (^cyan;Immortal Resolve^reset;, effects not covered by FU, etc.). If you have 100 health and 10% HP Regen, it will grant your pet 10 HP per second. If a stat isn't here, a pet most likely does not inherit it.
^yellow;Special notes^reset;: Be mindful when taking powerful buffs like ^cyan;Glass Cannon^reset;, as it will reduce their health noticeably.

FrackinUniverseは、大量の装甲(および食品)を追加し、いくつかの古いものを強化し、より多様なプレイスタイルを可能にします。 これらは、ゲームプレイを通じて非常に有用であり、非常に有用な利益をもたらすことができます!

^yellow;セットボーナスの継承 ^reset;:重要な注意として、他の装甲を作製するために使用される装甲は、製造チェーンで使用されたセットの装甲セットボーナスを完了するためにまだ使用できます。

^orange;能力値 ^reset;:バニラプレイヤーは、彼らが慣れ親しんだものよりも多くがあることに気づくかもしれません。 FUは、あなたの遊びをスパイスアップするための装甲クラスの広い範囲を提供し、食品で同じことを行います。

より被害に興味がある場合は、Power 防具またはHyper Power 防具を拾って、攻撃的なものに防御統計を交換してください。 または、タンクまたはハイパータンクをピックアップして敵を長持ちさせます。 彼らはメリーOR範囲で来ます! 戦いはあなたのものではない? 探索指向のセットを拾って、あなたの環境の中で家にいる! どこかでプレイスタイルに合ったセットを見つけることができます!

^orange;レジスタンス^reset;:FUの多くの装甲には固有の抵抗があります。 多くのバイオームの気象効果は、適切な量に達したら、あなたに影響しなくなり、さまざまな敵の攻撃はより少ない被害を与えます。 良いでしょう? 装甲をアップグレードすると、それらの抵抗が増加します!

^orange;ボーナス^reset;:ほとんどが統計に増加し、多くは条件付きです。
^green;+value ^reset; と表記するものは、一般に付加的な増加である。 でも、やや混乱することもある。 例えば:もしそれが +^green;3^reset;% クリティカル チャンスを平らにすることで、クリトリスチャンスを増加させます。 3%でも もしそうなら +^green;3^reset;% エネルギー・レーゲンは 3% 基地の 覚えておくべき最も簡単な方法は、自分自身に問いかけることです... 0 のベースがありますか? もしそうなら、それはおそらくクリティカル率のようなものです! ボーナスが x^green;1.3^reset;, または ^green;More ^reset; と表示されている場合、それは現在持っている値の乗数です。 1000% 何らかの損傷がありますか? 100% 以上 (または 2x) すると 2000% になります! 小さなメモ:レーゲンは通常一秒あたりです。

もちろん、いくつかのボーナスには、簡単には入れられない隠れたコンポーネントがあります。
 他にも、いくつかのフレーズで注意しなければならないことがある。もしセットボーナスが、関連する効果の^green;ALL^reset;に対して免疫を与えると述べれば、それは典型的には、すべての生物の天気^orange;と、その要素に関連する^reset;の特定のステータス効果を意味する。熱の場合、燃焼と溶岩でさえ含まれる!放射線の場合、ラッドバーンを含む。
小さなサイドノートとして、いくつかの用語やシンボルはゆるく使用されます。 x/yでボーナスを見た場合、それはボーナスが条件がどのように満たされているかに基づいて異なることを意味します。 武器の場合は、その種類の数を意味します。 マシンピストル(Machine ピストル)のようなものが表示される場合、それはマシンピストルまたはピストルにボーナスが適用されることを意味します。 これは、通常、ツールチップスペースに対して行われる。

^cyan;マイニング設定 ^reset;:
 採掘レーザー セットはもっと多くの 採掘レーザー ダメージ...しかし、何か他のものとペアリングしている場合、そのボーナスは大幅に減少します。 採掘レーザー 例えば ピストルを使って 2十 採掘レーザー 被害は 1.25Xだ
^orange; Colors ^reset; : ボーナスの識別と理解には色が重要です。 最初に、設定されたボーナスは ^yellow;^reset; によって識別され、 ^green;^reset; は抵抗を表示するためのインタフェースを作成する場合にのみ表示されます。 ボーナスステータスが ^green;GREEN ^reset; であれば、それは良いことです。 ^red;RED^reset;は悪いことを意味します。 ^cyan;Cyan^reset;はバイナリーのボーナスです。 通常は同様の効果を伴わない。 これは、さまざまな食べ物で特に明らかになります...ので、慎重に選択してください。 色に関するルールには、一つの例外があることに注意してください。 あなたが色でグローを見るならば、それは通常グロー効果の色です。

FrackinUniverse adds a large amount of armors (and foods) and enhances some older ones, allowing for a greater variety of playstyles. These can be very useful through gameplay and provide exceptionally useful benefits!

^yellow;Set Bonus Inheritance^reset;: As an important note, armors that are used to craft other armors can still be used to complete armor set bonuses for sets that were used in the crafting chain, so partially upgrading your set is still viable.

^orange;Stats^reset; : Vanilla players may notice there are more than they are used to, and even the ones they are used to have different ranges. FU presents a wider variety of armor classes to spice up your play, and does the same with food.

If you are more interested in damage, pick up Power Armor or Hyper Power Armor to trade defensive stats for offensive ones. Alternatively, pick up Tank or Hyper Tank sets to outlast your enemy. They come in melee OR ranged! Fighting not quite your thing? Pick up an Exploration oriented set, and be at home in your environment! You're guaranteed to locate a set that suits your playstyle somewhere out there!

^orange;Resistances^reset; : Many armors in FU come with inherent resistances. Many biome weather effects will simply stop affecting you once you hit an appropriate amount, and various enemy attacks will do less damage. Nifty, right? It gets better; upgrade your armor, and those resistances will increase!

^orange;Bonuses^reset; : Most are increases to your stats, plenty are conditional.
Any that say ^green;+value^reset; are typically additive increases. It can be a little confusing, however. As example: if it gives +^green;3^reset;% Crit Chance it increases your crit chance by a flat 3%, but if it says +^green;3^reset;% Energy Regen, that's 3% of your base. The easiest way to remember is to ask yourself...does it have a base of 0? If so, it likely is like Crit Chance! If a bonus says x^green;1.3^reset;, or ^green;More^reset;, that's a multiplier on the value you currently have. Have 1000% Damage somehow? 100% More (or 2x) would make it 2000%! Small note: Regen is usually per second.

Of course, some bonuses have hidden components we couldn't easily include, for tooltip space.
 Additionally, there are some other phrase uses to note. If a set bonus states that it grants immunity to ^green;ALL^reset; of a related effect, that typically means all biome weather ^orange;as well as^reset; specific status effects related to that element. For heat, that includes burning and even lava! For radiation, that includes rad-burn.
As a small side-note, some terms or symbols are used loosely. If you see a bonus with x/y, that means the bonuses are different based on how their conditions are met. For weapons, this means how many of that type. If you see something like (Machine) Pistols, that means the bonus applies to Machine Pistols OR Pistols. This is typically done for tooltip space.

^cyan;Mining Sets^reset; :
 Mining laser sets grant a lot more mining laser damage...but that bonus is reduced significantly if you are pairing them with something else. Using a mining laser with a pistol, as example: 2x Mining Laser Damage becomes 1.25x.
^orange;Colors^reset;: Colors are important in identifying and understanding bonuses. To start with, set bonuses are identified by a ^yellow;^reset;, while a ^green;^reset; is only visible in crafting interfaces to display resistances. If a bonus stat is ^green;GREEN^reset;, that means it is a good thing. ^red;RED^reset; means it is a bad thing. ^cyan;Cyan^reset; is for bonuses that are binary. They typically do not stack with similar effects. This will be especially apparent with various foods...so choose carefully. It is worth noticing that there is ONE exception to the rules regarding colors: Glow. If you see Glow in a color, that is usually the color of the glow effect.

^orange;Special Bonuses^reset; : Some sets have special bonuses that don't really display much information due to lack of space, an unfortunate limitation of the game. Here, some bonuses will be explained.

^cyan;Adaptive Armor^reset;: Multiplies the wearer's total defense based on current health percentage, scaling between the left value at 20% health and the right value at 100% health.

^cyan;Auto-Medic^reset;: More complicated than ordinary regeneration, this effect will restore more health per second at the cost of an equal percentage of energy. It will also decrease energy regen and increase energy regen lock-out multiplicatively at 2x the heal percent.

^cyan;Thorns^reset;: a nova of thorns when hit, ^cyan;Fire Burst^reset; makes a nova of fire instead.

^cyan;Summons Minions^reset;: summons short-lived allies to fight alongside you or distract enemies. These minions scale based on the lowest armor's tier, so upgrading it is essential! Upgrade ALL of the pieces.

^cyan;Life/Energy Shell^reset;: Gain damage absorption (shell) which scales based on a resource (health, energy) to protect your health, comes with a matching overhead bar to indicate its state. Regenerates quickly if you haven't taken damage recently. ^cyan;Shell Immunities^reset; are granted only while the shell holds. The numbers on the effect's label indicate the conversion rate relative to the resource's stats. In order: capacity, regeneration rate, and the delay upon taking damage before it begins regenerating.

^cyan;Life Shell^reset; specific: Regeneration rate is a direct percentage of health per second, lockout is in specified seconds.

^cyan;Energy Shell^reset; specific: Regeneration rate is a percentage of the energy regeneration stat, base vanilla regeneration is 58.5% per second. Special note due to balance: Minimum lockout time of 0.5 seconds, and a maximum regen rate of 50% per second.

^cyan;Gravity Normalization^reset;: Personal gravity too low? Up it goes. Too high? Down instead. Exception: Zero-gravity.

^cyan;Vital Power^reset; and ^cyan;Juggernaut^reset;: these effects are set bonus exclusive, and quite powerful; they grant one stat based on a percent of another. Vital power grants power as life, Juggernaut grants life as power.

^cyan;Undying Resolve^reset;: increases Protection as your life gets lower, up to the stated amount, while ^cyan;Immortal Resolve^reset; grants HP Regen instead. If a set grants either, it will grant ^cyan;Immortal Resolve^reset; to your pet.

^cyan;Dark Commander^reset;/^cyan;Beast Master^reset;: Increases Damage, Protection, HP and Speed of your pets (both) and crew (Dark Commander) by the listed percent, increases their jump ability by half of that, and regenerates HP at a sixth of that amount per second.

^cyan;Capturenaut^reset;: Increases pet count by 1, plus an additional 1 per 2 tiers (up to +2) of the lowest equipped set piece. Grants an additional +1 if using alongside the back item. This means a fully upgraded set will allow up to 5 additional pets!

^red;Wretchel Toxicity^reset;: Ingesting Wretchel reduces core stats and healing received, and drains health over time. These effects increase in severity the more you consume in a short time frame, as well as while your health is critically low. It will ^red;KILL^reset; you, if you are careless.

^cyan;Charisma^reset;: Your ability to bargain with Traders at space stations. The higher your charisma, the better the deal (and fatter your bank balance!)



^cyan;Pet/Crew Stat Inheritance^reset;:
Overall scaling is as follows: HP, directly from your character, rather than just equipped armor. Protection: applied as a multiplier to HP via a specific formula. Damage: directly from character sheet. Health Regen: Inherits as a flat amount, except in special cases (^cyan;Immortal Resolve^reset;, effects not covered by FU, etc.). If you have 100 health and 10% HP Regen, it will grant your pet 10 HP per second. If a stat isn't here, a pet most likely does not inherit it.
^yellow;Special notes^reset;: Be mindful when taking powerful buffs like ^cyan;Glass Cannon^reset;, as it will reduce their health noticeably.

^yellow;セットボーナスの継承 ^reset;:重要な注意として、他の装甲を作製するために使用される装甲は、製造チェーンで使用されたセットの装甲セットボーナスを完了するためにまだ使用できます。

^orange;能力値 ^reset;:バニラプレイヤーは、彼らが慣れ親しんだものよりも多くがあることに気づくかもしれません。 FUは、あなたの遊びをスパイスアップするための装甲クラスの広い範囲を提供し、食品で同じことを行います。

より被害に興味がある場合は、Power 防具またはHyper Power 防具を拾って、攻撃的なものに防御統計を交換してください。 または、タンクまたはハイパータンクをピックアップして敵を長持ちさせます。 彼らはメリーOR範囲で来ます! 戦いはあなたのものではない? 探索指向のセットを拾って、あなたの環境の中で家にいる! どこかでプレイスタイルに合ったセットを見つけることができます!

^orange;レジスタンス^reset;:FUの多くの装甲には固有の抵抗があります。 多くのバイオームの気象効果は、適切な量に達したら、あなたに影響しなくなり、さまざまな敵の攻撃はより少ない被害を与えます。 良いでしょう? 装甲をアップグレードすると、それらの抵抗が増加します!

^orange;ボーナス^reset;:ほとんどが統計に増加し、多くは条件付きです。
^green;+value ^reset; と表記するものは、一般に付加的な増加である。 でも、やや混乱することもある。 例えば:もしそれが +^green;3^reset;% クリティカル チャンスを平らにすることで、クリトリスチャンスを増加させます。 3%でも もしそうなら +^green;3^reset;% エネルギー・レーゲンは 3% 基地の 覚えておくべき最も簡単な方法は、自分自身に問いかけることです... 0 のベースがありますか? もしそうなら、それはおそらくクリティカル率のようなものです! ボーナスが x^green;1.3^reset;, または ^green;More ^reset; と表示されている場合、それは現在持っている値の乗数です。 1000% 何らかの損傷がありますか? 100% 以上 (または 2x) すると 2000% になります! 小さなメモ:レーゲンは通常一秒あたりです。

   ^#FF612F;Fuel-Based Generators^reset;
   ^blue;------------------------^reset;

Bad for the environment and good for your factory, fuel-based generators are the backbone of any serious early- to mid-game lab or factory, producing significant power.

All fuel-based generators work using a Heat system. When fuel is first placed in the generator, or it is turned on, it will consume one fuel item and begin heating up. Its heat level, which reaches maximum productivity after 18-20 seconds, either partially or fully determines the power output of the generator. In some generators the chosen fuel determines only how quickly the generator consumes fuel, and in some the chosen fuel also provides power on top of that generated by its heat.

When a fuel-based generator is turned off, by supplying an 'off' signal to its first blue input node, it will finish consuming its current fuel item before ceasing operation to avoid wasting fuel.


^#BA893F;Alternator Generators^reset;

The first generator a player will gain access to. The Alternator Generator can only consume wood and coal, though these materials are abundant on most worlds. The Alternator Generator will only produce ^#BA893F;4W^reset; at full heat (reached after 18s), and so it should be quickly replaced by the ^gray;Combustion Generator^reset; or another power source.

Accepted fuels (burn time):
----------
Wooden Log (10s), Coal (16s), Golden Wood (20s), Redwood Bark (20s), Penumbral Bark (30s), Alien Weird Wood (40s), Energy Wood (50s), Aen Wood Log (60s)


^gray;Combustion Generator^reset;

A serious power source for a growing industrialist, the Combustion Generator accepts the greatest variety of fuels of any generator and can produce a respectable amount of power from both solid and liquid fuels, including wood, erchius and fuel canisters. The Combustion Generator produces ^gray;12W^reset; of power at full heat (reached after 18s).

   ^blue;------------------------^reset;

Make sure to dispose of the waste cleanly (or profitably). Decay-based generators output power by gradually and randomly consuming isotopes over time. Uniquely, these generators come with multiple fuel slots, giving them the ability to vary their power output by filling the desired number of slots to adapt to any required workload without changing the fuel type, though each fuel slot may use different fuel if desired.

Decay-based generators will turn off immediately when an 'off' signal is supplied to their first blue input node, and will not waste fuel in doing so.


^red;Hydraulic Dynamo^reset;

An honourable inclusion, the Hydraulic Dynamo is an early-game generator that evaporates water using hot solids and liquids (or liquid nitrogen) in order to generate power. Although very large, it outperforms many other early generators despite being craftable on the first world and fuelled by trivially-obtainable substances such as lava and core fragments. The Hydraulic Dynamo can generate up to ^red;21W^reset; at maximum output, but will not function without water, consuming one for each fuel item used. The Hydraulic Dynamo has three fuel slots.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Lava (4W, 10s), Core Fragment (5W, 40s), Liquid Iron (6W, 32s), Volatile Powder (7W, 40s), Scorched Core (7W, 180s), Liquid Nitrogen (6W, 20s)


^#CEF400;Fission Reactors^reset;

Good old-fashioned nuclear power, the greenest thing about it is the uranium it consumes. Fission Reactors are an affordable way to create significant amounts of power, reaching up to ^#CEF400;360W^reset; across their four fuel slots. Uniquely, this generator creates Tritium Rods as a by-product of its fission, with a 50% chance for one to be made each time a fuel item is consumed. It will also create Toxic Waste, two if Tritium is created and one otherwise. While active, depending on how long it's been operating and how much power it's generating, the Fission Generator will begin to flood its nearby area with Moderate Radiation, up to 16 tiles away. Walls and other containment will not block this, only distance and Moderate Radiation immunity will help.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Tritium Rod (10W, 40s), Deuterium Rod (15W, 50s), Uranium Rod (20W, 90s), Plutonium Rod (30W, 90s), Neptunium Rod (40W, 90s), Thorium Rod (50W, 90s), Enriched Uranium Rod (60W, 120s), Enriched Plutonium Rod (80W, 180s), Solarium Star (80W, 240s), Ultronium Rod (90W, 300s)


^#B7E3E5;Small Fusion Reactors^reset;

Harness the power of the stars for your lab, albeit on a very small scale. Fusion Reactors of both kinds fuse light isotopes together, releasing nuclear energy from them to create power. Like the Fission Reactor, Fusion Reactors generate Moderate Radiation the longer and more productively they operate, which cannot be blocked. Small Fusion Reactors have four fuel slots, and can generate ^#B7E3E5;360W^reset; when filling all of them. They must be given coolant to continue operating or will quickly overheat and shut down, releasing a burst of radiation, though water is typically sufficient. Each consumed fuel will create one Toxic Waste, which can be used as coolant in a pinch.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Hydrogen (15W, 50s), Tritium Rod (25W, 60s), Helium-3 (45W, 80s), Solarium Star (55W, 150s), Deuterium Rod (60W, 120s), Ultronium Rod (90W, 700s)

Accepted coolants (heat reduction per item)
Toxic Waste (10), Salt Water (30), Water (30), Liquid Nitrogen (80), Cryonic Extract (125)


^cyan;Large Fusion Reactors^reset;

Originally pioneered by the Skath, Large Fusion Reactors are simply better-built, scaled-up versions of Small Fusion Reactors with a greater power output. Filling their four slots, they can generate up to ^cyan;600W^reset;. They generate radiation and produce Toxic Waste as Small Fusion Reactors do.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Hydrogen (35W, 50s), Tritium Rod (55W, 60s), Helium-3 (60W, 80s), Solarium Star (105W, 150s), Deuterium Rod (90W, 120s), Liquid Deuterium (90W, 120s), Ultronium Rod (150W, 700s)

Accepted coolants (heat reduction per item)
Salt Water (20), Water (30), Toxic Waste (40), Liquid Nitrogen (80), Cryonic Extract (125)

Dos & Don'ts:

  Do daisy-chain multiple containers. Use ITDs to draw items out of a container dumped to by another ITD to help automatically compress item stacks where possible and to give you more item-specific storage space.

  Do not try to move large amounts of items into a container which already has many items in it. Do not daisy-chain ITDs. These are sources of lag, and ITD configurations do not stack without a separating container.
translation:
Dos & Don't:

  複数のコンテナをデイジーチェーン化して、ITDを使って別のITDによってダンプされたコンテナからアイテムを引き出し、可能な限りアイテムスタックを自動的に圧縮し、アイテム固有のストレージスペースを提供します。

  大量のアイテムを、すでに多くのアイテムがあるコンテナに移動しようとしないでください。デイジーチェーンのITDはしないでください。これらは遅延の源であり、ITD構成はコンテナを分離せずにスタックしません。

Dos & Don'ts:

  Do create branching ITD trees along a string of containers where you feel you need to.

  Do Not create any sort of infinite back-and-forth loop that shifts the same items between the same containers unless you have a very good reason to do so. This can be a substantial source of lag.
translation:
運用のコツと注意点：

  必要に応じて、並べた収納容器に沿ってITDの経路を分岐させてください。

  明確な理由がない限り、同じアイテムを同じ容器の間で延々と往復させる無限ループは作らないでください。大きな処理遅延の原因になります。
